KaamAI Synthetic Business Policy (Test Fixture)
Document ID: DOC-FIXTURE-001
Organization: Synthetic Freelance Studio

1. Payment Terms
All client invoices are subject to standard Net 30 payment terms from the date of invoice issuance.
Late payments will incur a late payment charge of 1.5% per month on all outstanding overdue amounts.

2. Refund Policy
Refund requests must be formally submitted in writing within 14 calendar days of service delivery.
Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 business days.

3. Business Operations
Standard business operating hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.
Emergency server support is available 24/7 via support@synthetic-company.example.invalid.
